contrainte|analyses|analyses_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
contrainte|analyses|analyses_psi_mobile_score_check|CHECK (((psi_mobile_score >= 0) AND (psi_mobile_score <= 100)))
contrainte|analyses|analyses_siren_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (siren) REFERENCES companies(siren) ON DELETE CASCADE
contrainte|blocklist|blocklist_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
contrainte|blocklist|blocklist_siren_or_email|CHECK (((siren IS NOT NULL) OR (email IS NOT NULL)))
contrainte|campaigns|campaigns_interval_minutes_positif|CHECK ((interval_minutes > 0))
contrainte|campaigns|campaigns_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
contrainte|campaigns|campaigns_score_threshold_check|CHECK (((score_threshold >= 0) AND (score_threshold <= 10)))
contrainte|companies|companies_campaign_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
contrainte|companies|companies_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (siren)
contrainte|companies|companies_website_source_check|CHECK ((website_source = ANY (ARRAY['places'::text, 'osm'::text, 'manual'::text, 'introuvable'::text])))
contrainte|leads|leads_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (siren)
contrainte|leads|leads_score_check|CHECK (((score >= 0) AND (score <= 10)))
contrainte|leads|leads_siren_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (siren) REFERENCES companies(siren) ON DELETE CASCADE
contrainte|runs|runs_campaign_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
contrainte|runs|runs_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
contrainte|runs|runs_status_check|CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'success'::text, 'partial'::text, 'error'::text])))
